const patients = [ { id: 'P1001', name: 'John Doe', dob: '1985-03-15', gender: 'Male', lastShared: '2025-08-10', recordsCount: 5, prescriptionsCount: 3 }, { id: 'P1002', name: 'Jane Smith', dob: '1990-07-22', gender: 'Female', lastShared: '2025-08-12', recordsCount: 3, prescriptionsCount: 1 }, // Add more patients as needed ]; const stats = { totalPatients: 42, prescriptionsWritten: 127, filesViewed: 89, recordsShared: 56 }; const filteredPatients = patients.filter(patient => patient.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) || patient.id.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ); const handlePrescriptionChange = (e, index) => { const { name, value } = e.target; if (index !== undefined) { const updatedMedicines = [...prescription.medicines]; updatedMedicines[index][name] = value; setPrescription({...prescription, medicines: updatedMedicines}); } else { setPrescription({...prescription, [name]: value}); } }; const addMedicineField = () => { setPrescription({ ...prescription, medicines: [...prescription.medicines, { name: '', dosage: '', frequency: '' }] }); }; const removeMedicineField = (index) => { const updatedMedicines = prescription.medicines.filter((_, i) => i !== index); setPrescription({...prescription, medicines: updatedMedicines}); }; const submitPrescription = () => { // API call to save prescription console.log("Prescription submitted:", prescription);
